name: std::make_exception_ptr

declarations.code:
template <class E>

std::exception_ptr make_exception_ptr(E e) noexcept;

sections.title: Parameters
sections.text:
e

 -

 exception object to create a reference to the copy of

sections.title: Return value
sections.text: An instance of std::exception_ptr holding a reference to the copy of e, or to an instance of std::bad_alloc or to an instance of std::bad_exception (see std::current_exception).

sections.title: Notes
sections.text:
The parameter is passed by value and is subject to slicing.
